title: The Final -e
subtitle: Pronounced when meter requires it, silent otherwise.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: The final -e is pronounced as a schwa when: (1) required by meter, (2) after a single consonant following a short vowel, (3) in the dative singular of nouns, (4) in the plural of weak verbs. Silent otherwise. Chaucer's iambic pentameter depends on counting the final -e correctly.
